Package index

Import and preprocessing

Four readers, one output contract. Each converts a quantification report into the same proteomics_data object, so everything downstream is independent of the search engine.

preprocess_spectronaut()
Preprocess Spectronaut reports
preprocess_diann()
Preprocess DIA-NN protein-group matrices
preprocess_tmt()
Preprocess Proteome Discoverer TMT exports
preprocess_lfq()
Preprocess Proteome Discoverer LFQ exports

The analysis pipeline

process_proteomics() runs normalisation, optional batch correction, imputation and differential abundance in order. The individual stages are exported too, for workflows that need them separately.

process_proteomics()
Process proteomics data
normalize_proteomics()
Normalize proteomics data
batch_correct_proteomics()
Batch Correction with BERT
impute_proteomics()
Impute proteomics data
de_analysis_proteomics()
Perform differential expression analysis on proteomics data

Choosing a normalisation method

Ranks methods on properties of the data themselves, with no ground truth required. Pass methods to compare the twelve methods; without it the assays already in the object are ranked instead.

normalization_metrics()
Generate quality metric plots for normalization comparison
nm_compute_metrics()
Compute quantitative group-separation metrics per normalization method
nm_prepare_se()
Prepare a SummarizedExperiment from a proteomics_data object
nm_run_normalizations()
Run multiple normalization methods from a baseline assay
import_norm_matrices()
Import normalized matrices into a SummarizedExperiment
nm_rank_final()
Compute a combined final ranking across PCV, PMAD, PEV, Correlation and group-separation (PC1 F-ratio)
nm_rank_pcv()
Rank normalization methods by median PCV (ascending – lower is better)
nm_rank_pmad()
Rank normalization methods by median PMAD (ascending – lower is better)
nm_rank_pev()
Rank normalization methods by median PEV (ascending – lower is better)
nm_rank_cor()
Rank normalization methods by median intragroup correlation (descending – higher is better)
nm_rank_pc1()
Rank normalization methods by PC1 variance explained
nm_rank_mds1()
Rank normalization methods by MDS1 variance explained
nm_plot_final_ranking()
Horizontal bar chart of combined final ranking
nm_plot_metrics()
Bar chart of group-separation metrics per normalization method
nm_plot_boxplot()
Intensity boxplot per method
nm_plot_density()
Density plot per method
nm_plot_correlation()
Intra-group correlation boxplot per method (PRONE-style)
nm_plot_pcv()
PCV boxplot per method (PRONE-style)
nm_plot_pmad()
PMAD boxplot per method (PRONE-style)
nm_plot_pev()
PEV boxplot per method (PRONE-style)
nm_plot_pca()
PCA scatter plot per method

nm_plot_mds1_ranking()

nm_plot_scatter()
Sample-vs-sample scatter plot per method (NormalyzerDE style)

Choosing an imputation method

Simulated missingness on complete rows. The masking hides observed values, so the ranking measures MAR recovery: use it for the MAR stage, not to choose an MNAR one.

imputation_metrics()
Generate imputation quality metric plots and ranking
im_compute_metrics()
Compute imputation quality metrics (NRMSE, SOR, PSS, ACC_OI)
im_prepare_se()
Build a SummarizedExperiment for imputation benchmarking

im_plot_ranking()
Ranking heatmap of imputation methods
im_plot_metrics()
Faceted bar chart of all 4 imputation quality metrics
im_plot_nrmse()
NRMSE bar plot per imputation method
im_plot_sor()
SOR bar plot per imputation method
im_plot_pss()
PSS bar plot per imputation method
im_plot_acc_oi()
ACC_OI bar plot per imputation method

Benchmarking one pipeline against a spike-in

With a known ground truth, how well a pipeline recovers the expected changes. A positive counts only when it is significant and in the expected direction.

Interactive tables

Reactable tables for reviewing results. *_reactable() returns the table alone; *_widget() returns a complete page with a toolbar and Excel export.

Full Widget with Filters, Search, Export and CSS
protein_list_reactable()
Interactive Reactable Table for Protein_ID Data (post-Spectronaut)
protein_list_widget()
Full Widget for the Protein_ID Table with Filters, Search and Excel Export
quant_list_widget()
Full Widget for the Protein_QUANT Table with the log2 Matrix Appended
summary_list_widget()
Interactive Reactable Table for the Sample Metadata

The .nadia archive

One DuckDB file holding a whole analysis: data, parameters and provenance, with the reconstruction stored as SQL views rather than duplicated rows.

Write a complete analysis to a single .nadia file

nadia_result()

Rebuild the preprocessing object from a .nadia file
nadia_tables()
List the contents of a .nadia file without loading it
nadia_connect()
Open a connection to a .nadia file
nadia_export_parquet()
Export the tables of a .nadia file to Parquet
nadia_add_pattern_profiler()
Add a Pattern Profiler run to an existing .nadia file
nadia_pattern_profiler()
Rebuild the Pattern Profiler table from a .nadia file

Differential abundance with clusters, from a .nadia file

A preprocessed DIA dataset: three conditions, four replicates, 2,000 protein groups, 8.1 % missing. The trimmed reports for all four input formats live in inst/extdata/.
